target_findings.explanation: At disableTransfers(bool), the checked privileged change restricts the outgoing right of ordinary holders for an otherwise usable request within the recorded domain.

The assessment concerns a common restriction on ordinary outgoing transfers at source offset 1057 under transfer_condition. The scoped controller change prevents the same positive outgoing use for ordinary holders without an applicable exempt agent. A committing use and its control direction were checked on the actual ledger.

At mint(address,uint256), the checked privilege permits positive additional rights for the controller or a beneficiary it can select. A balance increase for an independent ordinary buyer alone does not satisfy this condition.
